title: Ernie Gawilan adds silver to Asian Para Games haul, hopes to inspire others
summary: Filipino para swimmer Ernie Gawilan hopes his success at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games will inspire persons with disabilities who have lost hope.
